final_report: T32 offline verification PASS (verified). Compile OK, focused suite 37/37 pass, full suite 336 pass + 4 pre-existing failures (real .env BROT_API_KEY pollution, not regression). Thought filter strips Gemma4 <|channel|>thought blocks correctly for whole/split/multiple/empty and streaming handles split markers via buf/longest=18 plus ignores reasoning_content. teach/latex validate and reject duplicate_action_ids / case-insensitive script_content. Config defaults https://ollama.com/v1 / gemma4:31b-cloud / searxng_url="" with BROT_* names preserved via validation_alias. Ollama base_url normalization appends /v1 for bare ollama.com case-insensitive and strips trailing slashes. SearXNG search returns [] on ConnectError/500/json error and respects max_results. SSE /turns and structured outputs both guard search_web with try/except so streams still work when searxng_url set. OpenAPI discriminates on kind for all 6 envelopes.
